categories.name: Fire
categories.notes:
Fires do not stack with each other.
Only provides comfort when lit.
Hearth provides more comfort.
Hearth provides the Fire effect at a range of 12m while an extra 1 comfort at a range of 8m.

categories.name: Rug
categories.notes: Rugs do not stack with each other, only one rug will provide a bonus.

categories.name: Table
categories.notes:
Tables do not stack with each other.
Darkwood provides the most comfort.

categories.name: Chair
categories.notes:
Chairs do not stack with each other.
Any "throne" provides the most comfort.

categories.name: Bed
categories.notes:
Beds do not stack with each other.
Dragon bed provides more comfort.

categories.name: Banner
categories.notes:
Banners do not stack with each other.
Jute Curtains do not stack with Banners or each other

categories.name: Plants
categories.notes:
Plants do not stack with each other.
Mistletoe, Yule garland, and Yule wreath can only be built during Yule events or with debug mode.

categories.name: Stands
categories.notes:
Stands do not stack with each other.
Does not need to be displaying an item.

categories.name: Bathroom
categories.notes:
Bathroom items do not stack with each other.
Hot tub only provides comfort when heated.

categories.name: Lights
categories.notes:
Lights do not stack with each other.
Jack-o-turnip can only be built during Halloween or with debug mode.
Snow lantern rapidly loses durability and breaks in any biomes except the Mountain and Deep North.

categories.name: Ashlands
categories.notes: Ashlands items do not stack with each other
